qcReview.tool: scripts/data/qc_render.py arcade-xca-2 <outDir> (decodes the packed DICOM and draws every target) plus pre-build overlay sheets for the segment-only frames
qcReview.selectionRule: A: 42 frames in both ARCADE tasks that passed round one's review and were not packed there. B: 70 syntax-only frames, taken at even steps through the md5-ordered pool of frames with at least four segments (36 right / 60 left drawn and reviewed by eye), then thinned to 28 right / 42 left for the file budget.
